name: Nepeta Leijon
source:
Nepeta Leijon, also known by her Trollian handle, arsenicCatnip, is one of the trolls.

She likes friendly roleplaying and has a naïve view of everything. She lives in a cave and hunts and eats animals, then occasionally wears their fur and paints with their blood. In fact, she uses this blood along with soot and ash to create wall art, such as storyboards for a comic and her shipping wall.

Her associated zodiac sign is Leo. She is of olive blood caste.

[From [url=https://mspaintadventures.fandom.com/wiki/Nepeta_Leijon]MSPA Wiki[/url]]
